output.summary: A rhizomatous perennial iris native to temperate and tropical Asia, fringed iris spreads by wiry runners into dense carpets. Its pale blue, lavender or white flowers have fringed petals and a yellow or orange crest.
output.edibilityNote: In Japan, ground rhizomes provide starch; however, rhizomes and leaves are poisonous if mistakenly ingested and can cause stomach pain and vomiting.
